name: fireworks
code: let cps=window.state.cps||0.56;if(window.state.t0===undefined)window.state.t0=millis()/1000;let elapsed=millis()/1000-window.state.t0;let cyc=(elapsed/(1/cps))%1;let beat=Math.max(0,Math.sin(cyc*Math.PI*2));let s=window.state;if(!s.fw)s.fw={rockets:[],sparks:[],last:-1};let bi=Math.floor(elapsed/(1/cps));if(bi!==s.fw.last&&(bi%4===0)){s.fw.last=bi;s.fw.rockets[s.fw.rockets.length]=({x:width*(0.2+Math.random()*0.6),y:height,ty:height*(0.2+Math.random()*0.3),hue:Math.random()*360});}push();blendMode(ADD);noStroke();for(let i=s.fw.rockets.length-1;i>=0;i--){let r=s.fw.rockets[i];r.y-=7;fill(r.hue,60,100,30);ellipse(r.x,r.y,5,10);if(r.y<=r.ty){for(let k=0;k<28;k++){let an=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp=1+Math.random()*3.5;s.fw.sparks[s.fw.sparks.length]=({x:r.x,y:r.y,vx:Math.cos(an)*sp,vy:Math.sin(an)*sp,hue:r.hue,life:1});}s.fw.rockets.splice(i,1);}}for(let i=s.fw.sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=s.fw.sparks[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.05;p.life-=0.02;if(p.life<=0){s.fw.sparks.splice(i,1);continue;}fill(p.hue,70,100,p.life*30);ellipse(p.x,p.y,4,4);}blendMode(BLEND);pop();
